newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN QUICK DOWN 10% ON GLOOMY OUTLOOK.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN QUICK DOWN 10% ON GLOOMY OUTLOOK.

text.p: Shares in Belgian fast-food chain Quick opened ten percent lower at 2,290 francs and then fell further to 2,280 francs on Tuesday after the group said on Monday that first-half consolidated net profit plunged to seven million francs from 147 million in the first-half of 1995.
The group also said that it expected full-year 1996 profit to fall 30 to 35 percent.
One dealer said that if Quick were to keep its historic price-earnings ratio of around 17, the full-year earnings forecast should knock the share price to 1,900 francs.
"But I expect that bargain-hunters will be coming in around 2,200 francs," he added.
The Bel-20 index was down 0.27 percent at 1755.33 points.
